purpose: Focused protected-mode runtime evidence for the natural W1L1 death-to-respawn boundary after the static recovery closure.

method.input: KBD_right held for 1600 input frames after W1L1 startup; callback records sampled every 10 frames

death_hold.interpretation: The sampled record is the delayed death presentation state. The exact unsampled setter and hold counter remain open.

recovery_entry.register_caveat: The watch stopped with ES=0 and DI=0x0348, so its object snapshot is invalid; only the watched entry and captured globals are used.

first_recovered_callback.interpretation: The first callback after the observed 1AAA entry already sees the indexed spawn position, idle mode, zero velocity, and the 3156 animation state.

entries.01F7:1AF5: restores health from DS:8824, selects spawn row zero, and calls 01F7:1B01
entries.01F7:1B01: NE relocation resolves the far call to 01F7:1AAA
entries.01F7:1AAA: loads DS:8828 + 4*DS:85D2 into player position, writes callback 3F27 and +0x29=1, clears DS:89EA, and loads descriptor 3156
entries.01D7:4BA4: consumes the transition gate and performs the lifecycle/rebuild branch; timer ownership remains external

closed: A natural W1L1 run enters 01F7:1AAA at the observed recovery boundary.
The next sampled player callback has the statically expected spawn, reset motion, mode, animation descriptor, and persistent callback identity.
Health is restored to three and lives remain three across the observed recovery entry and first recovered callback.
The recovered player remains object offset zero with callback 01F7:3FF8; no semantic meaning is assigned to scheduler append indices.
still_open: Exact death setter ownership and the unsampled frame at which 19E6 or 199D is entered.
The timer/IRQ condition that ends the delayed death presentation hold.
Exact object teardown, scheduler-bank rebuild, and resource reload ordering inside the 4BA4 lifecycle path.
Native LevelSession death/recovery implementation and held-out full-record parity.
conclusion.implementation_rule: Do not replace the remaining external timer and teardown contracts with a guessed fixed countdown.
